epic-init-onboard.title: Complete Init/Onboard 100% Coverage
epic-init-onboard.description: Three paths to perfection: (1) wogi-init fresh wizard, (2) wogi-init with reference project, (3) wogi-onboard existing/mature project. Wire pattern extraction → persistence, add missing pattern categories, template extraction, git-based temporal analysis, function-map/api-map generation, conflict resolution. AI-written code must be indistinguishable from reference/existing project code.

epic-universal-registry.title: Universal Registry & Framework-Driven Scanner
epic-universal-registry.description: Replace hardcoded file patterns with framework-driven discovery, and replace three fixed maps with an extensible registry system that adapts to any tech stack. Fixes Prisma multi-file schema scanning bug.

epic-teams-t3.title: T3: Team Knowledge + Integrations
epic-teams-t3.description: Team rules CRUD with cascade, team templates, knowledge sharing (models, skills, config), and external integrations (Jira, GitHub). Builds on T1 (auth) and T2 (sync engine) foundations. Bitbucket deferred to T4+.

epic-teams-t4.title: T4: Approval Flow
epic-teams-t4.description: Cross-user pattern aggregation, approval request workflow with review queue dashboard, 4 promotion pipelines (correction→decision, pattern→rule, learning→knowledge, team→global), notification system (in-dashboard + email), and team analytics dashboard. Builds on T3 (team knowledge + integrations) foundation.

epic-teams-t5.title: T5: Marketplace & Global Knowledge
epic-teams-t5.description: Marketplace for templates, skills, and knowledge packs with browse/search/install, publisher verification program, star ratings, and download tracking. Global Knowledge team curation layer extends Community Knowledge (C1-C2) with team-level promotion flow. Team model intelligence aggregation and memory export.
